derivation: Bounded wasm-bindgen wrapper combining cfb 0.14.0 (OLE/CFB container listing), msi 0.10.0 (Windows Installer database table decode), and cab 0.6.0 (MSCF decompression). The CFHEADER/CFFOLDER/CFFILE directory walk is hand-rolled in src/cab.rs so cab_list can report per-file folder offsets, reserved header/folder/data fields, and previous/next cabinet names that the cab crate does not expose; the cab crate performs bounded decompression inside cab_extract. All dependencies are exact-pinned crates.io versions resolved by Cargo.lock; no vendored source or patches.
